thesis: The page is a hull hauled out at the dock: a boot stripe runs along every section, and as you scroll the gloss climbs down over the chalk until the whole page sits at the waterline.

signature.name: Boot Stripe
signature.summary: A painted hull waterline stripe (navy 6px over coral 3px, 3px gap) ending in an SVG bow chevron that marks each section; above it is finished surface, below it chalky gel-coat stipple. Draws under the hero bow mask, becomes the Nov-Oct season track the bow rides on, splits services into Driveway (above) and Dock (below), becomes the measuring rule of the hull calculator, stands vertical as the claim-path spine, carries the review cards like a dock line, and ends as the footer's full-bleed waterline. Hook: data-sw-signature='boot-stripe', drawn by --sw-p.

palette.family: Intracoastal Teal + Gel-Coat White + Boot-Stripe Coral + Chart Navy

layoutMoves: hull-bow shape mask bleeding off the right edge with the boot stripe painted on it and continuing under the h1
split-horizon section: car services above the stripe, boat services below, collision on the line
horizontal Nov-Oct season rail pinned on desktop, each season band its own tint
drawn hull profile that stretches with the length input in the calculator
vertical stripe spine for the claim path steps

motion.intro: h1 lines mask up (70ms stagger, 700ms) while the boot stripe draws left to right (600ms from 200ms) and the chalk stipple veil under the waterline wipes off (700ms); under 1.1s, skippable, text readable from first paint.
stories: Seasons (slide): pinned >=640px at 4*55svh+100svh, the month rail translates X, the bow chevron rides the stripe and the band tint crossfades per season; stacked clip-reveal cards under 640px.
Hull calculator (stretch): the drawn hull scales in X with the length input over 200ms and its stripe ticks redraw.
motion.hover: The coral line of the boot stripe grows under links and cards, scaleX 0 to 1 from the left, 200ms.
